x: He is coached by Mick Dunphy and names Lasse Viren as his athletic inspiration. Winning the Scottish AAA Youth 800m in 1980 has given Stuart his most pleasing performance so far whilst losing and running on bad tracks are amongst his athletic dislikes.
It is interesting to note that this year Stuart has raced a carefully planned schedule set by his coach, Mick Dunphy, as long as last winter.
